headline: Petrol prices rise continuously; Ministry of Industry and Trade issues urgent request
summary: Vietnam's Ministry of Industry and Trade asked key enterprises to ensure sufficient petroleum supplies, especially diesel, in the fourth quarter. It also told them not to hoard goods.
why: Fuel prices and supply affect transport costs and inflation across the economy, and governments often intervene when shortages or price spikes arise.
